mechanism: Prednisone (CYP3A4 inducer) increases albendazole metabolism, reducing its anthelmintic efficacy; albendazole may increase prednisone metabolism; concurrent use increases infection risk in immunocompromised patients.
action: Monitor therapeutic efficacy of albendazole; consider dose adjustment or alternative anthelmintic; assess need for prednisone dose optimization; ensure adequate infection control monitoring.
